scope: Offline distal workspace model only. No controller calls, proximal IK, physical interval readbacks, collision tests, scene changes or motion authorization.
calibration: All six closure TCP rotations/positions and their immediately previous accepted cut-advance commands. Fit only one scalar: the median pitch-pivot distance from RCM minus insertion, using the installed dVRK wrist transforms and recorded wrist yaw.
validation: All six distinct pre-advance readbacks in the same two archives, paired to the latest earlier confirmed closed ALIGN tool command. Require every reconstruction within 0.01 degrees shaft yaw/pitch, 0.01 mm insertion and 0.001 radians wrist pitch/yaw. These are within-archive model checks, not independent scene validation.
screen: Use predecessor's frozen row center and approach/backoff samples, both original views, the three corresponding closed-blade TCP rotations per view, and the same 0/3/4/5 mm positive transverse_x translations and independent +/-0.5 mm perturbations. Hold each TCP rotation fixed exactly; solve the distal shaft line and wrist angles from the closed-tip geometry. Require modeled shaft, insertion and wrist limits with native margins, plus yaw in [-2.5,+1.0] degrees. Do not infer scene reachability from this screen.
